prompt: UI mockup of a VS Code chat sidebar panel, dark theme, portrait crop, minimal like Claude Code. The header row shows the current session title "Fix login timeout ⌄" in normal weight with a small "+" icon at right. A dropdown overlay is opened under the title: a search field "Search sessions" at top, then sessions grouped under small muted headers "Today", "Yesterday", "Last week". Each session is one line: title on the left, right-aligned muted relative time "2m", "1h", "3d". Running sessions have a tiny pulsing dot before the title, a session waiting for input has a small amber dot. Current session has a check mark. Bottom row of the overlay in muted text "Show archived". Crisp readable text, compact, calm.
